By preparing early, the party ensures they won't be caught flat-footed, keeping the race against Susan Collins competitive.

The party promises a transparent process (HOW), but refuses to release any details of how it works until Platner actually drops out (WHEN).

To prevent public panic and division, the party uses the pretext of 'ongoing planning' to delay transparency. They seek to control the outcome while projecting unity.

The Unavoidable Truth: The party will prioritize winning the seat over a truly open, bottom-up process.

The Unavoidable Lie: The succession plan is being built in real-time with public input.
